biotools.summary: Teknonaturalist is a Snakemake pipeline for rapid detection and classification of pathogenic and endophytic fungi from plant genomic DNA, targeting the ITS region for taxonomic assignment. It provides methods for maximizing query sequence length and provides taxon-specific local cut-off and confidence scores.
